text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence where computers learn from data without being explicitly programmed. One common approach is supervised learning. In this method, the computer is given training data, which consists of input examples and their correct outputs. For instance, you might show the computer many pictures of cats and dogs, each labelled correctly. Using this data, the computer builds a model—a kind of mathematical rule—that can identify patterns. After training, the model can make predictions on new, unseen data. The accuracy of these predictions is then measured to see how well the model has learned.
